artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan lifting the state-locality fragment to L-plus, retiring stab_atom_of_atom, and relating the three notions across the tower.

memory_candidates.content: When a syntactic fragment predicate is lifted from one language of a tower to a lower one (L-star -> L-plus here), the transfer lemma along the embedding (ofPlus) cannot live in the lower module: any consumer of the lower fragment then acquires a dependency on the upper tower, inverting the layering. The resolution is a third module above both, importing each. Symptom to watch for: the lower fragment module is imported by a conservativity/soundness file that has no business knowing about the upper language. Same shape recurs whenever a bridge lemma names symbols from two layers.
